# AI Dev Workspace

> Shared Markdown task memory for developers who switch between Claude Code and Codex. Save decisions, next actions and dead ends in files you own; configured local hooks provide a task brief at session start. Install `pipx install ai-dev-workspace --pip-args='--pre'`, then run `ws start` in a Git repo to preview setup. Python 3.9+ CLI (`ws`) and local stdio MCP server; MIT licensed.

## Stable — published 0.1.0b6

- Local Markdown task records, explicit `ws remember`, `ws checkpoint` and `ws brief`.
- Seven core MCP tools by default; other tools remain callable by name.
- Claude Code and Codex have live checks on macOS. Cursor, Copilot and Gemini
  integrations are fixture-tested; Linux/Windows have CI, not live-client proof.
- Only saved information is remembered; automatic transcript capture is best-effort.
- The optional guards pack is a safety net, not a security boundary.

## Preview

- Private team sharing needs preview/review before sharing; no hosted team check yet.
- The Claude Code plugin is live-checked on beta.5 but not yet listed in
  Anthropic's official plugin directory. Install from our GitHub marketplace;
  the CLI and `ws start` in the target repo are still required.

## Released in beta.6

- Stable: bounded compact MCP recall, read-only stack audit and the advisory behavior pack.
- Preview: opt-in digest advice is size-only; tool output is not compressed automatically.
- Preview: worker fallback runs only declared providers and read-only roles;
  gateway delegation is checked only with a local fake server and sends a redacted brief.
- Stable: lesson promotion drafts advice only; skills packaging is format-checked,
  without a verified third-party installer run.
- Preview: claude-mem import is fixture-tested against a checkpointed SQLite schema;
  newer schemas may not import.
- Preview: Antigravity rules, MCP and SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks are fixture-tested;
  there is no signed-in live proof or automatic capture.
- Preview: Claude Code plugin needs the CLI and `ws start`; not in Anthropic's
  directory, Windows untested. Codex plugin hooks need a trusted manual desktop install;
  no MCP in the plugin, no live hook proof. Cursor plugin is fixture-tested only,
  not submitted, with no verified install command. [Plugin limits](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/blob/main/docs/ADVANCED.md#plugin-runtime-packaging-preview).

## Coming next

Common Agent Plugins root manifest (PLG3) and repo discovery through MCP roots (PLG5)
are parked and not released. The Codex plugin still uses `ws start` for MCP.
